_comment: Manifest of the knowledge library. Generated, do not edit by hand. The runtime loader for the signed knowledge package is unchanged; these files are read by host tests and by the engine owner when it wires them in.

parts.description: Verse-count index of the bundled KJV. Rejects references to chapters or verses that do not exist.
Doctrine status register. Topic status only (APPROVED, UNDER_REVIEW, UNDECIDED, DRAFT_PENDING_LEVI). Fail-closed.
Kenyan contacts with their verification status, as recorded by Levi, and constitutional summaries with citations (DRAFT_PENDING_LEVI).
Source register: licence, URL and approval status of every reference source.
Kenyan pastoral-support topics. Verse text from the bundled KJV only. DRAFT_PENDING_LEVI. Fail-closed.
Creed and confession texts awaiting approval: Apostles' Creed and the Westminster Confession (historical, not a Perazim position). DRAFT_PENDING_LEVI. Not read by any loader until Levi approves them.

notYetInLibrary: Cross-references, dictionaries and places: still in assets/reference/reference.db.gz (loaded by ReferenceIndex).
Commentaries: still in assets/reference/reference-commentaries.db.gz (optional; loaded by ReferenceIndex).
Bible text: still in assets/bible/text (loaded by the Bible reader and OfflineScriptureLookup).
Operating files: still in assets/ai/guide (loaded by GuideDocs).
